page.layout: One page of text, running head at top right, page number at top left. Below the text, one woodcut ornament with no text. Catchword at right below the last line. No margin notes.

main_text.l: In Compositis vocibus unaquæq; pars sejungatur:
Hisce Grammatices Latinæ brevibus quidem præ-
ceptis, absolutis tamen, non contenti, Domini Phi-
lippi Melanchthonis Grammaticam, Petri Rami, vel
Qui autem omnium Latinarum vocum signifi-

page.notes: The catchword "GRAM:" is cut off at the right page edge; the full word is probably GRAMMATICA, so it is given as far as it is visible. The ornament below the text is a woodcut and is not transcribed. Hyphens and dashes are kept as printed: "Abs—traho" and "præter—eo" use dashes, and the line-end hyphens are kept.
